summary.text: Poppy Arford is a Democratic state representative from Maine House District 101, who lives in Brunswick, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election against Republican Ravi Jackson.

paragraphs.text: Arford earned a B.A. in social work from the University of Southern Maine in 1981.

Her career experience includes work as program director of SHAREcenter, a substance abuse counselor with Community Alcoholism Services and a patient advocate, and she has volunteered as a mediator with the Maine Attorney General Consumer Mediation Service.
She serves on the Health Coverage, Insurance and Financial Services Committee.
In a 2020 Ballotpedia survey, Arford said she was passionate about affordable, publicly funded health care, public education, clean energy and gun violence prevention.
